newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli opens fibre optic plant in Brasil.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli opens fibre optic plant in Brasil.

text.p: Italian tyre and cablemaker Pirelli is opening a new fibre optic plant in Sorocaba in Brasil which will have an initial annual production capacity of 300,000 kms of fibre optics, the company said in a statement.
Pirelli said it had invested around $25 million in the factory, which is due to open on Friday and will be Pirelli's fourth fibre optics plant.
The plant's capacity would rise to 600,000 kms per year in three years, making it the biggest factory for the production of fibre optics in south America, it said.
Output would be used at Pirelli's fibre optic cable factories in Brasil and Argentina as well as sold to outside parties.
